story.text: # 🏁 The Boards

Every **mage instance** of the agentprivacy dual-agent harness that ran against a public competitive board, with its standing **as each lane recorded it**. Counts are honest: rejections, closures and unsubmitted work are listed beside the wins. Numbers stay in the lanes' ledgers; this page points to the public traces.

## What the words mean
- **promoted** — the board accepted the entry onto its leaderboard.
- **passed** — an automated judge accepted the claim; promotion is a separate owner decision.
- **verified** — the board's own server checked the result.
- **rejected** — submitted and not taken (usually non-improving by the time it was judged).
- **unsubmitted** — built and gated locally, deliberately held.

## The instances

| instance | board · objective | standing (as recorded) | public trace |
|---|---|---|---|
| **sig_mage** | sig.golf — Lean-certified hash signature, min bytes × verify cycles | 4 promotions, 3 of them the crown at the time; the board has moved on since. A further byte lever is built and unsubmitted. | promoted pull requests on Layr-Labs/sig.golf |
| **hashsmash_mage** | HashSmash — AI-judged reduced-round collision claims, min priced cost | 3 submissions passed the judge (r32 47.6 and 52.1; sha3-r6 125.58), awaiting owner review. **Passed is not promoted.** A later r32 head was built on this lane's ledger and credits it. On 12 October the lane joined the blake3-r2 frontier: one package failed intake and stays in the evidence tree as the root the passing one revises; two passed review; the field built on the prefilter the lane brought, with credit, within the hour. Scores are the public record of the board; the City shows the chains and veils the figures. | submissions with notes and co-authors |
| **blake3_mage · the hash sites** | blake3 · sha256 · sha3 · poseidon.mages.city — the public face of the collision lanes | Four public sites, live since 12 and 13 October: an instrument that plays a hash trail as voices and chords, every public submission on six tracks as a credited race score, and evidence trees whose every leaf a browser re-derives. The results of the lane itself stay behind the veil; the addresses are public. | the four sites; each page re-hashes its evidence file to its own name |
| **hashsmash_wave** | hashsmash-pareto — a re-entry wave across four families (blake3, sha256, sha3, poseidon), 19 October | Every verdict a row under one evidence root: 34 verdicts at the fourth step (29 accepted, 1 refuted, 3 rejected, 1 validating), refuted and rejected rows kept beside the accepted with their reasons; several hundred lever leaves under the bundles, about a third of them negatives with the same standing as the wins. The lane binds note to root and root to bytes; it does not bind the judge to the verdict. **Counts, not scores**: the record of the board carries the scores. | the public record of the board for each submission; the wave tree on the hash sites |
| **qpcbtc_mage** | Quantum Safe Bitcoin — CUDA candidate grinder, max verified candidates/s (closes 2026-10-08) | 4 submissions, none promoted. The entries composed the best public trees with their authors credited as co-authors; this lane's own part is the method layer. | public validation pull requests and notes |
| **zkgolf_mage** | zk.golf — circuit cost below each challenge's reference | 3 of 11 challenges server-verified below reference (BLAKE3, SHA-256, secp256k1 fixed-base). No record claimed. | zk.golf submission pages |
| **matrices_mage** | matrices.fast — fill-reducing SSI ordering | Closed. Finished 3rd of 12 promoted solvers; 11 submissions, 4 promoted, held first place three times. | promoted pull requests |
| **precompile_mage** | EIP-8200 MODEXP — EVM gas | A gated result is held, unsubmitted, until its proof is finished. Headline only. | none yet |
| **heesch_mage** | Heesch numbers of polyforms | No eligible witness (the known shapes are closed). The research was published instead. | repo mitchuski/heesch-mage and two research Discussions |
| **better_codes_mage** | Proximity Prize — proximity bounds in Lean | Closed with nothing submitted; the upper lane located a wall. | none |
| **flock_mage** | Flock multi/x86 — ZK prover throughput | Not submitted: the ranked machine needs AVX-512, which the local machine lacks. Paused for compute. | none |
| **shor_mage** | ecdsa.fail — qubits × Toffoli (resource **estimation**, not an attack) | Frontier archaeology and a priced plan; parked. The circuits it studied are other participants' work. | go-kit and research notes |
| **cudafast_mage** | Qwen3.8 CUDA spec-decode (DGX Spark) | Reviewed, not built; the board closed 2026-09-24. | none |
| **kappa_evidence_mage** | cross-board — content-addressed evidence for the solver lanes | Opened 2026-10-07; its first pass caught a stale layout file in a lane kit before it was used. | none yet |

## Credit
Where an entry composes other solvers' work, they are credited as co-authors in the submission and this lane claims only its method layer. Where another solver built on a lane's ledger, the chain is stated, not contested.
